# AbstractNote

> One endpoint for everything you want to remember: notes, files, photos, recordings and logs are filed with their time, place and provenance and grow a temporal semantic knowledge graph you can search by effort (quick, standard, deep) and revisit through time. Part of the AbstractFramework; runs on AbstractGateway, AbstractRuntime, AbstractFlow, AbstractMemory and AbstractCore. Version 0.2.0: `pip install "abstractnote[gateway]"` (AbstractGateway 0.17.0 or later, AbstractRuntime 0.15.0, AbstractMemory 0.4.0) and the web app `@abstractframework/note` on npm.

Start with README.md and docs/getting-started.md. docs/api.md is the reference for the runs API usage, the note read API under /api/gateway/note, the note tools, the Python API and the abstractnote CLI. docs/faq.md lists the limits of this version; docs/troubleshooting.md maps messages to fixes.

## Core Docs
- [README.md](README.md): project overview, what you get, install, quick start, clients
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, a headless notebook in five minutes, then the gateway path with the web and watch apps
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): principles, components, data plane, request lifecycles, dependencies and boundaries
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): runs API usage, note read API routes and pinned shapes, note tools, Python API, CLI
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): common questions and the limits of this version
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): messages and symptoms, causes, checks and fixes
